text:
emily_prod: Quick note 
we just cut contrib-guides v1.0.0 to the community org: https://github.com/redwood-inference/contrib-guides/releases/tag/v1.0.0 :tada: 

release-bot: Release created: contrib-guides v1.0.0 by @emily_prod 

raj_s: love it. does this bundle the new PR template and the issue-triage playbook? 

emily_prod: yes 
- PR template (small/medium/large labels) 
- triage playbook (oncall steps + priority matrix) 
- maintainer etiquette guide (how to close stale threads) 

ines_docs: i'll take the docs ownership for the first pass on the handbook pages and add a short checklist for new contributors. planning to add screenshots and a short video snippet. 

laura_eng: heads-up the eng-runtime team will adopt the triage playbook next sprint. can we add a short bit about backport signals for patch-only repos? 

emily_prod: good point, laura 
added a "backport signals" subsection and a sample workflow for patch branches. it's in section 4.1. 

release-bot: Asset uploaded: contrib-guides-v1.0.0.zip (signed) 

community-bot: FYI: Automating contributor onboarding badge is now live for the repo (first-run pipeline will message new PRs). 

raj_s: can we get a short blurb for the community newsletter? 2-3 lines + link and a call to action to review templates. i'll draft. 

emily_prod: please do, raj. tag @ines_docs and i'll approve. planning a small community meetup next month to walk through the playbook too. :calendar: 

laura_eng: count eng-runtime in for the meetup. 

emily_prod: thanks all 
if anyone spots gaps, open an issue labeled "contrib-guides" and assign to @emily_prod or @ines_docs. :sparkles:
